$comment: The models a visitor may choose from, per role. THIS IS AN ALLOWLIST AND IT IS THE ONLY LIST THAT COUNTS. The browser sends a model id; the backend rejects anything not named here. Without that, a public URL is an invitation to spend the project's OpenRouter credit on the most expensive model available, seven calls at a time.
$verification: Every entry must (a) appear under openrouter.ai/models?supported_parameters=response_format, because the runner sends response_format json_object with require_parameters and a model without it 404s, and (b) be cheap. Prices move and catalogues change: check before adding, and do not add a model on the strength of a summary. That mistake cost two runs in turn 004.
$default_note: This is the fallback only. The committed per-role allocation lives in modelMap() in src/config.js and remains the artifact the model-progression argument rests on. A visitor's choice is an override on that default for one run; it is not the project's model decision.
